from typing import Annotated
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition

from .task import TaskConfiguration


class JobContext(BaseModel):
    """Context about the job position being discussed."""

    title: str = Field(description="Title of the job position")
    description: str = Field(description="Detailed description of the job position")
    company: str = Field(description="Company offering the job position")
    location: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Location of the job position"
    )
    contract_type: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Type of contract (W2, 1099, etc)"
    )
    start_date: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Expected start date for the job position"
    )
    schedule: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Schedule information for the job position"
    )


class CallScriptContext(BaseModel):
    """Context for Call Script"""

    job: JobContext = Field(description="the job position being discussed.")
    candidate: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate prior to the call",
    )
    knowledge_base: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Knowledge base for the job position"
    )


class CallScript(BaseModel):
    """Script for an AI faciliated call with candidates. This object will be immutable"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the call script")
    call_script_schema_version: str = Field(
        description="Version of the call script schema"
    )
    call_script_version: str = Field(description="Version of the call script")

    candidate_data_point_schemas: dict[str, CandidateDatapointDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="dictionary of all candidate datapoint schemas referenced in the call script",
    )
    context: CallScriptContext = Field(description="Context for the call script")

    tasks: list[
        Annotated[TaskConfiguration, Field(discriminator="task_agent_type")]
    ] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of call node configurations")

"""
Purplefish API client wrapper for agent operations
"""

from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timezone
from typing import Any
from typing import Dict
from typing import Optional

import httpx

from commons.monitoring import logging
from commons.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer
from commons.schemas.purplefish import CreateEngagementResponse


logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


class PurplefishClient:
    """Wrapper for Purplefish API operations with enhanced logging and tracing"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        agent_tracer: Optional[AgentTracer] = None,
        timeout: float = 30.0,
    ):
        """Initialize Purplefish API client

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL for the Purplefish API
            api_key: Optional API key for authentication
            agent_tracer: Optional tracer for monitoring
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds
        """
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.tracer = agent_tracer.get_tracer(__name__) if agent_tracer else None

        # Configure headers
        self.headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if self.api_key:
            self.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.api_key}"

        # Create HTTP client
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers=self.headers,
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(self.timeout),
        )

        logger.debug("PurplefishClient initialized", extra={"base_url": base_url})

    async def create_engagement(
        self,
        room_name: str,
        opportunity_id: Optional[str] = None,
        candidate_phone_number: Optional[str] = None,
        agent_phone_number: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> CreateEngagementResponse:
        """Create a new engagement

        Args:
            room_name: Name of the LiveKit room
            opportunity_id: Optional opportunity ID
            candidate_phone_number: Optional candidate phone number
            agent_phone_number: Optional agent phone number

        Returns:
            CreateEngagementResponse with agent_name and engagement_id
        """
        if self.tracer:
            with self.tracer.start_as_current_span(
                "purplefish.create_engagement"
            ) as span:
                span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)
                if opportunity_id:
                    span.set_attribute("opportunity.id", opportunity_id)
                if candidate_phone_number:
                    span.set_attribute("candidate.phone", candidate_phone_number)

                try:
                    # Build request payload
                    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"roomName": room_name}

                    if opportunity_id:
                        payload["opportunityId"] = opportunity_id
                    else:
                        # Use phone numbers if opportunity_id not provided
                        if candidate_phone_number:
                            payload["candidatePhoneNumber"] = candidate_phone_number
                        if agent_phone_number:
                            payload["agentPhoneNumber"] = agent_phone_number

                    # Make API request
                    response = await self.client.post("/api/engagements", json=payload)
                    response.raise_for_status()

                    result = CreateEngagementResponse(**response.json())

                    span.set_attribute("engagement.id", result.engagement_id)
                    span.set_attribute("agent.name", result.agent_name)

                    logger.info(
                        "Engagement created successfully",
                        extra={
                            "room_name": room_name,
                            "engagement_id": result.engagement_id,
                            "agent_name": result.agent_name,
                        },
                    )

                    return result

                except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
                    span.set_attribute("error", True)
                    span.set_attribute("error.type", "HTTPStatusError")
                    span.set_attribute("error.status", e.response.status_code)

                    logger.error(
                        "Failed to create engagement",
                        extra={
                            "room_name": room_name,
                            "status_code": e.response.status_code,
                            "error_detail": e.response.text,
                        },
                        exc_info=True,
                    )
                    raise

                except Exception as e:
                    span.set_attribute("error", True)
                    span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)

                    logger.error(
                        "Failed to create engagement",
                        extra={
                            "room_name": room_name,
                            "error_type": type(e).__name__,
                        },
                        exc_info=True,
                    )
                    raise
        else:
            # Version without tracing
            try:
                # Build request payload
                payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"roomName": room_name}

                if opportunity_id:
                    payload["opportunityId"] = opportunity_id

                # Make API request

        agent_tracer: Optional[AgentTracer] = None,
        timeout: float = 30.0,

        """Initialize Purplefish API client

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL for the Purplefish API
            api_key: Optional API key for authentication
            agent_tracer: Optional tracer for monitoring
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds
        """
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.tracer = agent_tracer.get_tracer(__name__) if agent_tracer else None

        self.headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if self.api_key:
            self.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.api_key}"

        # Create HTTP client
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers=self.headers,
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(self.timeout),

def camel_to_snake_case_dict(data: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively convert camelCase keys to snake_case in dictionaries
    
    Args:
        data: The data to convert (can be dict, list, or other)
    
    Returns:
        The converted data with snake_case keys
    """
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, value in data.items():
            # Convert camelCase to snake_case
            snake_key = ""
            for i, char in enumerate(key):
                if char.isupper() and i > 0:
                    snake_key += "_" + char.lower()
                else:
                    snake_key += char.lower()
            result[snake_key] = camel_to_snake_case_dict(value)
        return result
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        return [camel_to_snake_case_dict(item) for item in data]
    else:
        return data

def camel_to_snake_case_dict(data: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively convert camelCase keys to snake_case in dictionaries
    
    Args:
        data: The data to convert (can be dict, list, or other)
    
    Returns:
        The converted data with snake_case keys
    """
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, value in data.items():
            # Convert camelCase to snake_case
            snake_key = ""
            for i, char in enumerate(key):
                if char.isupper() and i > 0:
                    snake_key += "_" + char.lower()
                else:
                    snake_key += char.lower()
            result[snake_key] = camel_to_snake_case_dict(value)
        return result
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        return [camel_to_snake_case_dict(item) for item in data]
    else:
        return data

def camel_to_snake_case_dict(data: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively convert camelCase keys to snake_case in dictionaries
    
    Args:
        data: The data to convert (can be dict, list, or other)
    
    Returns:
        The converted data with snake_case keys
    """
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, value in data.items():
            # Convert camelCase to snake_case
            snake_key = ""
            for i, char in enumerate(key):
                if char.isupper() and i > 0:
                    snake_key += "_" + char.lower()
                else:
                    snake_key += char.lower()
            result[snake_key] = camel_to_snake_case_dict(value)
        return result
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        return [camel_to_snake_case_dict(item) for item in data]
    else:
        return data

logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


def camel_to_snake_case_dict(data: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively convert camelCase keys to snake_case in dictionaries

    Args:
        data: The data to convert (can be dict, list, or other)

    Returns:
        The converted data with snake_case keys
    """
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, value in data.items():
            # Convert camelCase to snake_case
            snake_key = ""
            for i, char in enumerate(key):
                if char.isupper() and i > 0:
                    snake_key += "_" + char.lower()
                else:
                    snake_key += char.lower()
            result[snake_key] = camel_to_snake_case_dict(value)
        return result
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        return [camel_to_snake_case_dict(item) for item in data]
    else:
        return data


class PurplefishClient:
    """Wrapper for Purplefish API operations with enhanced logging and tracing"""

    def __init__(
        self,

            api_key: Optional API key for authentication
            agent_tracer: Optional tracer for monitoring

        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")

        self.headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if self.api_key:
            self.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.api_key}"

        # Create HTTP client
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers=self.headers,
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(self.timeout),
